goal: Introduce the first guarded AH cutover: keep proven AuxVmangos transaction execution as rollback backend, but require current-generation AuxEconomyShadow positive exact candidate parity before shadow-authoritative real actions can arm; fail closed on any mismatch.
notes: Gameplay evidence #309 on parallel be68344e showed shadow installed/hooks intact, observerErrors=0, 1214/1214 decisions at 100% with cutoverReady=true, but every decision was both-reject. Pre-cutover audit found CandidatePipeline exports selectedPostscan while the passive bridge reads result.selected. This feature fixes that interface via the cutover compatibility wrapper, requires a live positive exact-match candidate in the current hot generation, keeps zero tolerance for shadow-extra/shadow-miss/different-candidate/lifecycle-diff, and wraps only AuxVmangos-owned PlaceAuctionBid phases. Before first positive match the proven active owner passes through unchanged; a recorded mismatch blocks that candidate and disarms cutover. No QueryAuctionItems/CancelAuction/StartAuction ownership is added.
